claim: Sam's Coffee in the binnenstad is Zwolle's top-rated specialty coffee bar (4.9/5, ~987 reviews), with the owner personally selecting beans per customer at no extra cost.
quote: Sam's Coffee (Binnenstad) Rating: 4.9/5 (987 reviews) Roaster: Sam's Coffee Notable for highest-rated specialty café in the city

claim: Espressobar Maling and Barista Café Zwolle are central specialty-coffee spots pairing skilled baristas with cakes and lunch options.
quote: Espressobar Maling Location: Zwolle center Signature: Specialty coffees paired with bakery items Notable: Offers on-site barista services for events and parties

claim: Hier en Daar is praised as by far the best coffee in town from drip to flat white, with a small organic lunch menu and specialty beers and wines.
quote: By far the best coffee in town, from drip to flat white, with a small but high quality organic lunch menu and an impressive collection of specialty beers and wines.

claim: Engel Winkelcafé at Grote Markt 3 is a charming Zwolle lunch favourite for coffee, snacks and sandwiches in the central square.
quote: Engel Winkel Café offers the best coffee in Zwolle in the city center, with a charming spot for coffee, snacks, and sandwiches at Grote Markt 3.

claim: De Gillende Keukenmeiden (Meerminneplein 7) is a local lunch staple known for homemade cakes, high tea and a leafy garden terrace inside the canals.
quote: Screaming Kitchen Maids Address: Meerminneplein 7, Zwolle Known for: 'Homemade cakes [that] are irresistibly delicious' Popular feature: High tea service with outdoor seating

claim: 't Pannekoekschip, a Dutch pancake restaurant on a moored clipper ship in Zwolle, has been a city fixture for more than 30 years with fresh pancakes cooked in the galley.
quote: 'T Pannenkoekschip has been an established part of Zwolle for more than 30 years, with delicious pancakes baked in its galley.

claim: Stadscafé Het Refter on Bethlehemkerkplein 35a sits in one of Zwolle's oldest buildings and pours 24 specialty beers and wines on tap plus 200+ bottled varieties, with a partly-covered terrace under the Peperbus tower.
quote: The venue features 24 specialty beers and wines on tap, plus more than 200 bottled varieties... Situated in the middle of the historic Bethlehemkerkplein with views of the Peperbus

claim: Café Het Vliegende Paard on Voorstraat is Zwolle's largest student café with 80+ beers, a terrace and a Sunday pub quiz.
quote: Het Vliegende Paard is the largest student room in Zwolle... The café has over 80 different brands and types of beer.

claim: LOK Bier brews traditionally in Zwolle with local malt, own yeast and home-grown hops and won silver at the Dutch Beer Challenge 2020; Axes Castellum operates a brewery and tasting room out of a former Dominican monastery on Grote Voort.
quote: LOK produces various beer styles in Zwolle in a traditional manner, using local and regional products including their own yeast, malt from the region, and hops from their own cultivation.

claim: DAVO opened its third proeflokaal in central Zwolle in 2020 with 15 beers on tap, and Brouwerij Allema opened a city tasting room in April 2024.
quote: DAVO opened its third tasting room in the heart of Zwolle since 2020, with 15 beers on tap and more in the cooler.

claim: Café 't Beugeltje on Thorbeckegracht — housed in the historic Wine Carrier Tower — is Zwolle's signature canal-side terrace, specialising in Grolsch beugel beer with a view of the gracht's stepped-gable houses.
quote: Café 't Beugeltje – Thorbeckegracht Housed in a historic wine carrier tower, this venue offers 'a view of the beautiful canal houses across the street.' It specializes in Grolsch beugel beer.

claim: On the Grote Markt, Stadscafé Blij, In Den Hoofdwacht and Engel Winkelcafé form the cluster of cozy terraces that locals choose for people-watching and a beer.
quote: In recent years, more stores on the square have been exchanged for catering establishments including Stadscafé Blij, In Den Hoofdwacht and Engel Winkelcafé.

claim: Zwolse balletjes — boiled candies in mocha, cinnamon, vanilla and fruit flavours — have been hand-made since 1845 at Het Zwolse Balletjeshuis on Grote Kerkplein 13, the only candy in the Netherlands still produced in-shop.
quote: The Zwolse balletje is the only piece of candy in the Netherlands that is still produced 'at the shop' in the traditional way.

claim: Zwolse balletjes are recognised Dutch intangible heritage and have been continuously produced in the same Grote Kerkplein basement bakery since J. van der Kolk started in 1845.
quote: In 1845, J. van der Kolk started the production of Zwolse Balletjes in the 'steek' bakery in the basement of the historic building.

claim: Wijnbar OAK at Gasthuisplein 23 is Zwolle's dedicated wine bar with 50+ wines, a borrel programme, monthly tastings and Wine & Jazz nights — ideal for pre-dinner drinks.
quote: Wijnbar OAK is a wine and food bar in Zwolle where you can enjoy a glass of wine at the bar, an extended borrel with friends, or High Wine experiences.

claim: Beautanica on the Ossenmarkt pours 64 wines by the glass on a cozy square-side terrace, making it a Zwolle aperitivo option away from the Grote Markt crowds.
quote: Beautanica serves 64 different wines and has a cozy terrace on Ossenmarkt.
